EndDescription="With resistance on the ground quashed, you contact the ship. After a suspiciously long pause, Jandel answers the call wrapped in a towel, his hair dripping.|[12219]Jandel: Hi Captain! I hope everything went well, because someone used the last of your shampoo, and it'd be nice to have some good news to soften that blow.|[userprofile]You: 'Someone,' huh? Anyway I don't care about that. The base is secured, but there's no sign of Swallow. We need to run a deep scan, see if we can't find where he's hiding.|[12220]Jandel: Oh! Uh, I can probably answer that. Our onboard telemetry recorded a planetside launch a few minutes ago.|[userprofile]You: And you didn't think to mention that at any point prior to now?|[12224]Jandel: I was looking for more shampoo!|[userprofile]You: Set a trace on that ship by the time I get back, or I'll reconsider my choice not to kick you out the airlock." From what Ive heard, Mack Swallow himself is holed up in his old planetside base.
